days.check_in_prompt: What are you here to contribute? Write one sentence — your personal mission statement. Read it out loud. Does it feel true?
Look at your day. What one thing on your list directly serves your mission? Do that thing first, with full intention.

days.task: Run One Decision Through Your Purpose Filter
days.check_in_prompt: Today, before making any significant choice, ask: does this move me toward my mission? Share what you decided and why.
